(15 goals) | matches = 182 | total goals = 485 | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | average attendance = 2,347,897 | prevseason = [[2007 K League|2007]] | nextseason = [[2009 K League|2009]] | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest losses = }} The '''2008 K League''' was the 26th season of the [[K League]]. The regular season and playoffs' format was the same as the one used in the [[2007 K League|2007 season]]. It began on March 8, and the final of the playoffs finished on 7 December. On 2 August 2008, the first ever Jomo Cup kicked off. The K League All-Stars squared off against the [[J.League]] All-Stars at the [[Japan National Stadium]]. [[Lee Woon-jae]] was selected as the K League All-Star Team's captain and [[Cha Bum-kun]] managed the squad.
